map.复合肥为主时补施单质肥补齐短板元素。: When compound fertilizer dominates, top up with single-nutrient fertilizer to cover the deficient elements.
map.复合肥含量 15-15-15 什么意思？: What does a 15-15-15 compound fertilizer label mean?
map.指 N、P₂O₅、K₂O 质量百分比各 15%。注意磷钾是氧化物形式计，与元素量: It means 15% each by mass of N, P2O5 and K2O. Note that phosphorus and potassium are expressed as oxides, which differ from elemental content; when blending fertilizer, use the oxide contents declared on the label.
map.按目标养分投入反推单质/复合肥用量：用量 = 目标养分量 / 肥料养分含量。: Work backwards from the target nutrient input to the single/compound fertilizer rate: rate = target nutrient amount / nutrient content of the fertilizer.
map.某肥料用量 = 目标养分 ÷ (肥料含量% × 利用率%) × 面积；总成本 =: Fertilizer rate = target nutrient / (nutrient content% x utilization rate%) x area; total cost = total rate x unit price
map.测土给出『推荐施肥量』，但落地要拆成具体肥料品种与袋数。本工具把『养分需求』翻译: Soil testing gives a "recommended fertilizer rate", but to act on it you have to break that into specific fertilizer products and bag counts. This tool turns the "nutrient requirement" into "which product to buy and how much".
map.测土配方为什么还要算？: Why still calculate when a soil-test formula is given?
map.用于测土配方施肥的肥料结构设计。: Used for designing fertilizer structures in soil-test-based formula fertilization.
map.由目标养分需求量反推肥料实物量：除以「肥料含量百分比 × 当季利用率」得单位面积: Work backwards from the target nutrient requirement to the physical fertilizer amount: divide by (nutrient content percentage x seasonal utilization rate) to get fertilizer per unit area, then multiply by the area for the total; nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium are computed separately and summed. The nutrient ratio is reduced by the greatest common divisor for display as N:P:K. The higher the utilization rate, the less fertilizer is needed for the same target, which is useful for formula fertilization and reduction planning.
map.肥料配比计算器（N-P-K比例） 使用指南: How to use the fertilizer ratio calculator (N-P-K ratio)
map.输入作物目标养分需求量与施用面积，选择常用单质肥料，自动计算各肥料用量与总成本估: Enter the target nutrient requirement for the crop and the application area, choose common single-nutrient fertilizers, and the tool automatically computes each fertilizer rate and the total cost estimate.
